thread:
pagerbot: [PAGER] high latency detected on dedicated-pool-7 (region: us-west-2). p99 >= 12s for 3m, queue depth spiking >500. Paging oncall.
elaine: acked. investigating. seeing spike in requests -> lots of short-chat completions. assigning to samir.
samir: on it. first glance: pool utilization 98%, warmup rate low. many new containers reporting KV-miss and long cold-starts.
kai: filing context — traffic started ~1978889940, coincides with a customer load test hitting many small prompt echoes.
devon: are these streaming stalls or just long end-to-end? Grafana shows streaming stalls at token emission layer (stalls ~6-10s) and overall p95 ~2s, p99 ~12s.
elaine: customer-impact? product-ops any reports from top customers?
product-ops: two early-warning alerts from AcmeCorp and Nimbus — both reported timeouts in their ingest pipeline. marking user-impacting until mitigated. drafting a templated note.
ashok: quick mitigation idea: reduce batching window and route small requests to a lightweight quantized model pool. can we cherry-pick a compatible variant?
samir: routing change would help but autoscaler is sluggish — target-based scale up for dedicated pools has a 90s cooldown and warmup jitter. if we spin new instances they'll take ~60-90s to warm KV cache and GPU kernels.
kai: we can also temporarily increase max-inflight per-instance to lower queue depth. downside: higher tail latency per instance but overall reduces queue backlog.
devon: suggestion: 1) enable manual pool-surge for dedicated-pool-7 (add 6 nodes now), 2) reduce batching to 20ms, 3) route requests with <60 tokens to quant-pool-3. anyone object?
elaine: +1. samir you do manual surge? i'll coordinate customer comms.
samir: invoking manual scale: `rdwctl pools scale --pool dedicated-pool-7 --add 6 --reason \"emergent surge\"`
samir: logs: `scale request accepted`, provisioning 6 nodes — expected ready ~65s.
pagerbot: autoscaler: manual scale triggered by samir for dedicated-pool-7 (+6). new nodes provisioning.
kai: changing batching policy for pool in flight: `PATCH /internal/pools/dedicated-pool-7/config {\"max_batch_wait_ms\":20}`
kai: applying now.
devon: routing rule: `route small_requests -> quant-pool-3` added to routing table with fallback to dedicated-pool-7.
ashok: watch KV-warmup timeline — as instances come up they should fetch model shards and prefill KV cache. we should instrument kv_cache_hit_ratio per instance.
elaine: monitoring: queue depth starting to drop from 520 -> 200 -> 90 within 70s.
product-ops: customer notifications queued. will post a status update: \"Experiencing degraded latency for dedicated customers in US-WEST. Mitigations in progress.\"
samir: new nodes joined cluster. initial KV-miss rates high but emission stalls decreasing for new instances.
devon: p95 reduced to 1.4s, p99 dropping to ~4.8s over last 2m. streaming stalls still sporadic on older instances.
kai: running `rdwctl drain --pool dedicated-pool-7 --target older-instances --evict-sessions` to move traffic to warmed nodes.
kai: drain in progress. this should reduce tail stalls as we rely more on nodes with warmed KV.
elaine: any reason not to keep the extra 6 nodes for another 10m to ensure warm cache for returning bursts?
samir: fine to keep for now — set a 15m TTL. I'll also open a follow-up to reduce the autoscaler cooldown and add warm-up prefetching for model shards.
ashok: logging note: we observed \"queue amplification\" pattern: many small requests triggered extra async cache misses and increased lock contention on KV-store. need a mitigation plan (prefetch on scale, smaller batching for small tokens, smarter route hashing).
product-ops: status update posted. customers pinged with ETA ~10min for full recovery.
devon: p99 now ~2.3s, p95 ~0.9s, queue depth stable <40. streaming stalls almost gone.
pagerbot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV3 (service degradation) at 1978890360.
elaine: nice work. next steps: samir to file a postmortem, kai/devon to own immediate config improvements (batching defaults and routing for small token workloads), ashok to prototype prefetch warmup on scale events.
samir: already started: creating ticket INF-4112 \"Reduce autoscaler cooldown for dedicated pools and add fetch-before-join prewarm\".
kai: I'll open a short-runbook patch for oncall: if p99 > 5s and queue >200, manually scale + enable drain to warmed nodes.
devon: also add metric to alert on kv_cache_hit_ratio < 0.6 during scale events.
product-ops: customers notified of recovery and follow-up postmortem.
elaine: closing paging loop. final check: anyone see residual errors or SLO breaches persisted longer than we saw in metrics?
ashok: nothing else in logs. will run a synthetic sweep to validate.
samir: I'll own the postmortem write-up and link logs + dashboards. thanks team.
product-ops: thanks all :thumbsup:
_meta: thread generated for dataset: incident coordination covering queue amplification, warmup starvation, manual scaling and customer comms
